slug: 2025-11-27 Benin Cuts Digital Budget by 6.32% Despite Expanding Tech Ambitions

facts.fact: The Minister of Digital and Digitalisation presented to the National Assembly on 25 November 2025 a 2026 digital budget of CFA27.2 billion: CFA9.7bn operating and CFA17.4bn capital, across three programmes (Piloting and Support CFA2.1bn, Digital Programme CFA12.3bn, Media Programme CFA12.6bn).
facts.system: Ministry of Digital and Digitalisation budget 2026

facts.fact: The 2026 digital budget of CFA27.2bn is 6.32% lower than the CFA29.034bn approved for 2025, attributed mainly to a 12.22% fall in external financing.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital and Digitalisation budget 2026 (against 2025)

note: The budget is part funded by external financing, not wholly; the document does not say the rest is domestic by name but the ministry budget counts.
Revised finance law total and digital-economy tax measures (revenue side, to general budget) only; no digital ministry, agency or programme amount and no fund.
Revised finance law reallocations and video-protection (interior security) purpose; no amount for a digital ministry, agency or programme, no digital fund.
Companion page only: the RAPEX is image-only and the page states no figures.

facts.fact: The 2026 budget execution table in the PLFR note gives programme 111 Numerique credits (CP) of 12,372,151,413 FCFA and programme 100 Pilotage et soutien aux services du MND credits of 2,184,235,167 FCFA; the 111 capital line includes a 6,500,000,000 FCFA external loan tranche, so the line is part-paid by a loan.
facts.system: Programme 111 Numerique and Programme 100, Ministry of Digital (MND) budget 2026

facts.fact: Budget execution to 30 April 2026 shows programme 111 Numerique had ordonnance 77,247,968 FCFA of 12,372,151,413 FCFA (0.62%) and programme 100 had ordonnance 439,474,918 FCFA of 2,184,235,167 FCFA (20.12%); these are ordered payments, not paid amounts, and the ministry's line only.
facts.system: Programme 111 Numerique and Programme 100, Ministry of Digital (MND) execution 2026

note: Section 035 proposed increase (+11.7%) compares the same year's initial and proposed credits, so no rose fact; a bill not yet passed at this date.

facts.fact: The finance ministry's FY2025 budget execution report lists the Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation (035) with an initial 2025 appropriation of 29,033,966,192 FCFA; the remaining digits on the row, including any final or spent figure, are unreadable.
facts.system: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation budget 2025

note: Companion page only; the spent amount is not legible, so no spent fact.
Reports adoption of the 2026 finance law (3,783.984bn FCFA total) but names no digital ministry, programme, fund or levy.

facts.fact: The Minister of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation presented to the parliamentary budget committee a 2026 budget of 27,238,035,553 FCFA for her ministry (9,774,411,267 operating, 17,463,624,286 capital).
facts.system: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation budget 2026

facts.fact: Programme Numérique is allocated 12,372,151,413 FCFA in the proposed 2026 budget, with four flagship projects: broadband phase 2, digital uses and trust, Smart Gouv phase 2, and digital transformation of local authorities.
The ministry's 2026 credits of 27,238,035,553 FCFA compare with 29,033,966,192 FCFA in 2025, a fall of 6.18%, which the report attributes to a 12.22% fall in external financing.
facts.system: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation budget 2026

note: Figures are the proposed budget presented to committee; part of the ministry's money is external financing, not stated to be wholly loan-paid.
Stored as a cover line only; no body text and no digital figures.
Citizen version of the 2024 execution report gives state-wide revenue and spending totals only; no digital ministry, programme, fund or levy is named.

facts.fact: La Nation reports the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation presented a 2027 draft budget of FCFA 11.59bn to the National Assembly, with FCFA 7.74bn of investment financed wholly from own resources.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation 2027 draft budget

facts.fact: La Nation reports the ministry's 2027 draft budget of FCFA 11.59bn against FCFA 16,483,428,674 in 2026, a fall (printed as 29.29%) attributed to the externally financed Pitn2r project leaving its portfolio.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation 2027 draft budget
